jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented individual to develop advanced automotive SMART Power technologies, with a particular emphasis on device test structures, test programming and analysis. This role involves collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders, to ensure that automotive product and application requirements are met with precision and excellence. Join us in shaping tomorrow's power landscape today!

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

- Design test structures for Smart Power Technology development with focus on LDMOS transistors for device characterization, manufacturability analysis and production monitoring
- Setup electrical tests to characterize the transistor parameters
- Analyze the test results and propose optimizations to reduce deviations
- Understand the complex interaction of the many different devices produced at the same time in smart power technologies (LDMOS for different voltage classes, logic, Flash)
- Create and improve test routines on tester library
- Be the interface to other functions such as process integration, device simulation, reliability and failure analysis and product- development departments

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

- Degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related field
- Knowledge of semiconductor technologies, device characterization, and development processes
- Experience with electrical parameter test equipment
- Skills in scripting / programming
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a technical R&D environment
- Excellent English language skills, fluency in German is an advantage

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.
Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.
Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

The Institute of Pathology / LaBo[o]ratory of Nephropathology (https://www.ukaachen.de/kliniken-institute/institut-fuer-pathologie/forschung/labooratory-of-nephropathology/) is offering a

to interrogate autoimmune kidney diseases using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and bioimage analysis techniques, including deep learning

Operational area: Institute of Pathology / LaBo[o]ratory of Nephropathology

Working hours: 75% of the collectively agreed full-time working hours (currently 38.5 hours per week)

Duration/Term of employment: Initially limited till 30.09.2029, with option of prolongation until the completion of the doctoral degree

Start date: as soon as possible

Remuneration/Rates: EG 13 (TV-L)

Project Title: Dissecting immune cell crosstalk in autoimmune kidney diseases with spatial transcriptomics and pathomics. Institute for Pathology, RWTH Aachen

Within this project the PhD candidate will interrogate immune cell crosstalk and crescent formation in patients with autoimmune kidney disease (including IgA nephropathy, ANCA-glomerulonephritis and others). The PhD candidate will learn to train and deploy histology segmentation models as part of the Aachen Digital Pathology group, as well as the downstream analysis of morphometric features in conjuncture with spatial transcriptomics.

This PhD-Program is meant to built a new generation of scientists that are rigorously trained in the development and application of cutting-edge computational tools to generate digital biomarkers with translational clinical impact. This combined skillset will enable the candidate to excel in their further academic or industry career after concluding the PhD training.

The PhD-Project is embedded within the section of Translational Nephropathology at the Institute of Pathology, offering a comprehensive training programs for PhD candidates, peer-to-peer mentoring, lectures and lab meetings on translational kidney research, as well as possibilities for networking and presentations at scientific meetings. We are an interdisciplinary and international team of scientists and clinicians with a long-standing focus and expertise in developing novel methods for digital pathology, advanced image analysis and deep learning. Our hardware equipment comprises high-end computational infrastructure, with several GPUs (NVIDIA DGX A100), CPU clusters and storage systems.

Why you should choose us?

We offer…

- 30 days of vacation per year for full-time employment
- A bonus of 3,000 euros for employees who help recruit employees in different sectors
- An attractive company pension scheme from VBL
- Education opportunities, including updating and upgrading
- Access to public transport
- In-house kindergarten (places subject to availability)
- Staff residences (places subject to availability and by arrangement)
- An onboarding app for new employees
- Extended opening hours in the staff restaurant

Tasks

- Development of a pathomics model for H&E- and PAS-stained histological slides of autoimmune kidney diseases
- Application and refinement of techniques for joint analysis of pathomics and spatial transcriptomics
- Implementation of biostatistical and machine learning models for predicting clinical outcomes using joint biomarkers
- Writing scientific publications and presentation of scientific data at medical conferences

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated and curious PhD candidate who is eager to learn and apply new computational methods, takes ownership of a project, and drives it forward with a structured, reliable working style. Strong communication skills in English (Lecel C1) and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary teamwork are highly valued.

- Applicants should have a master's degree in biology, medicine, or a related field (e.g. engineering, molecular medicine, physics)
- Interested in working at the intersection of computational pathology and multi-omics. Ideally, applicants should have prior experience in either spatial transcriptomics or computer vision, ideally computational pathology approaches
- Development of a pathomics model for H&E- and PAS-stained histological slides of autoimmune kidney diseases
- Application and refinement of techniques for joint analysis of pathomics and spatial transcriptomics
- Implementation of biostatistical and machine learning models for predicting clinical outcomes using joint biomarkers
- Writing scientific publications and presentation of scientific data at medical conferences
- Motivation and eagerness to lean
- Ability to work indepedently / self-directed working
- Attention to detail
- Teamwork

Application:

The application deadline for the advertised position GB-P-56408 is October 16, 2026.

University Hospital of the RWTH Aachen, Institute of Pathology Section for Translational Nephropathology/AG Boor, Pauwelsstr. 30, 52074 Aachen.

Contact:

If you have any questions, please contact Univ.-Prof. Dr. med. Peter Boor PhD or Dr. med. David Hölscher

E-Mail: pboor@ukaachen.de / dhoelscher@ukaachen.de

Tel.: +49 (0) 241 80 35410

We look forward to receive your application.

This job advertisement is aimed at all genders.

The RWTH Aachen University Hospital promotes equal opportunity and diversity. Applications from women are expressly sought and, in accordance with relevant laws, will be treated preferentially.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities and they will be given priority if they are equally suitable.

Employment at a fraction less than the weekly full-time working hours stated above is generally possible.

It is preferable to use our digital application portal at www.karriere.ukaachen.de to apply. The portal allows you to upload your documents to an electronic application folder, which is protected from unauthorized access. Applications received by email are transferred to our application portal and then deleted in accordance with data protection regulations. (Transmission by email is usually inadequately protected.) If you do not agree to the transfer of your data to our portal, we unfortunately cannot consider your application. The data in the portal will be deleted after the retention period has expired.

Job Summary

We are an international manufacturer specializing in wire and strip forming machinery. We are looking for an experienced Sales Specialist (m/f/d) for our office, with hands-on experience in multi-slide forming machines. Responsibilities

- Develop sales activities in Germany and across Europe
- Visit potential customers and identify new business opportunities
- Understand customer needs and work with the engineering team to provide suitable machine solutions.
- Work with customers from the initial contact through to closing the sale.
- Participate in machine demonstrations, customer meetings, and trade fairs

Qualifications

- Experience with multi-slide wire or strip forming machines
- Experience visiting customers and working in field sales
- Ability to find new customers and develop business
- Good communication and negotiation skills
- Fluent in German (native-level preferred) and English

What We Offer

- Long-term career opportunity in a growing international company
- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
- An active role in the European market
- Flexible and supportive working environment

The Department of Pediatric Oncology, Hematology and Clinical Immunology at the University Hospital Düsseldorf (UKD) at the Heinrich Heine University (HHU), headed by Prof. Dr. Arndt Borkhardt, is one of the leading clinical centers for the diagnosis and treatment of childhood cancer in Germany. The German Diabetes Center (DDZ) is the Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf. The DDZ is an interdisciplinary research center linking molecular and cell biological basic with clinical and epidemiological research approaches. The DDZ has the aim to develop new approaches for prevention, early detection and diagnosis of diabetes mellitus and to improve therapy and treatment of its complications.
The Institute for Clinical Diabetology (Director: Prof. Dr. Michael Roden) is looking for an

Epidemiologist (postdoc - m/f/d) We are searching for a candidate with (1) a doctoral degree in epidemiology, (bio)statistics or a comparable discipline, (2) the ability to work in an interdisciplinary manner with physicians and life scientists, and (3) knowledge of epidemiological methodology and statistical analysis systems (e.g. SAS or R). In addition, excellent writing and communication skills in English are required. Experience in the analysis of proteomics data would be desirable.

The project will be a collaboration between the research group Inflammation (Prof. Dr. Christian Herder) and the Clinical Study Center (Prof. Dr. Robert Wagner, PD Dr. Oana-Patricia Zaharia) at DDZ.
